generic_domain.justification: Among the provided research domains, 'Concept Drift' is more generic and comprehensive. Concept Drift refers to situations where the statistical properties of the target variable in the model change over time. On the other hand, 'Virtual Concept Drift' is a specific type or subset related to how data is distributed across environments, which can fall under scenarios addressed by concept drift. Therefore, 'concept drift' encompasses the broader scope and serves as a superordinate category to 'virtual concept drift'.
